Title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Supply Chain Business Insights
Description: Description Help shape the data foundation behind one of Amazon's fastest-growing supply chain networks — and put AI in the hands of the people who move millions of packages across Mexico every day. This is your chance to build the pipelines, analytics, and cloud-native solutions that turn raw data into trusted, accurate intelligence for an organization at the forefront of GenAI adoption. As a Business Intelligence Engineer on the MX Supply Chain BI team, you will design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, reporting solutions, and analytical tools that power decisions across Mexico's Supply Chain — from network planning and capacity to last mile operations. You will work with large-scale datasets on AWS, write production-grade Python code, deploy cloud-based solutions, and partner with stakeholders across 10 functional areas to deliver insights that drive operational performance. You will contribute to the team's AI-ready data lakehouse platform and help embed GenAI and ML capabilities into the analytics portfolio. Key job responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/big-data pipelines using AWS services following medallion-architecture best practices Write production-grade Python code for data transformation, automation, statistical analysis, and integration with AI/ML workflows Build high quality datasets with robust metadata for agents to consume and give insights to our stakeholders. Deploy and manage cloud-native data solutions on AWS through infrastructure-as-code based deployments. Collaborate with stakeholders across Supply Chain functional areas (Topology, S&OP, Network Planning, Middle Mile, Last Mile, Sort Centers, Operations) to translate business questions into analytical solutions Contribute to the team's AI-ready data lakehouse platform (Apache Iceberg on serverless AWS), ensuring data quality, governance, and single-source-of-truth standards Write and optimize complex queries on SQL, Spark SQL and PySpark across large-scale datasets to support reporting, ad-hoc analysis, and metric development Establish and follow engineering best practices including code reviews, testing, monitoring, documentation, and logging best practices. Proactively identify opportunities to improve data availability, reduce time-to-insight, and automate manual reporting processes Support the team's GenAI/ML initiatives by preparing governed, high-quality datasets and contributing to data products that enable agentic and self-service AI workflows A day in the life You start your morning reviewing pipeline health dashboards and resolving any data quality alerts from overnight ETL runs. By mid-morning, you're deep in Python — building a new data transformation module. After a quick stand-up with your peers, you jump into a working session with a Last Mile stakeholder who needs a new metric added to their operational dashboard; you scope the requirement, write the code and push for your peers to review before lunch. You wrap up the day by prototyping a data integration that will expose a new dataset to the team's GenAI agent through the MCP — a small step that will let operations leaders ask natural-language questions about network speed and compliance. No two days are the same, but every day your work makes Supply Chain decisions faster, smarter, and more trusted. About The Team MX Supply Chain Business Insights owns the data, insights, and analytics that power how Amazon's Mexico Supply Chain organization understands its business, measures its customer experience, and makes decisions. The team serves 10 functional areas with growing cross-LATAM collaboration with Brazil. Our team works together to deliver the data infrastructure, pipelines, semantic layers, and reporting that underpin MX Supply Chain's most critical business metrics, while also developing full stack applications to gather and process data. We are at an inflection point: as we embed GenAI across the portfolio and scale an AI-ready data lakehouse across LATAM, the decisions our stakeholders make depend on data they can trust, access quickly, and act on confidently. Basic Qualifications 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience Experience using Python scripting to process data for modeling 3+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience Experience using SQL (Structured Query Language) to pull data from a database or data warehouse Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines Bachelor's degree or above in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools Experience with AI/ML technologies Experience building and operating a cloud-based architecture Preferred Qualifications Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets Experience developing and presenting recommendations of new metrics allowing better understanding of the performance of the business Experience with forecasting and statistical analysis Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Title: Data Engineer II
Description: Job Description Zendesk is looking for a customer-focused Data Migration Engineer II to help enterprise customers successfully migrate their business-critical data into and out of Zendesk. This role combines software engineering, data engineering, customer consulting, and AI-assisted development to design scalable migration solutions that enable successful customer implementations. As a Data Migration Engineer II, you will partner directly with customers, Project Managers, Technical Architects, and Product teams to understand complex business requirements and translate them into secure, reliable, and efficient migration solutions. You will build reusable migration tooling, automate repetitive processes, leverage AI-assisted development to improve engineering productivity, and continuously improve the migration experience for both customers and internal teams. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, working directly with customers, building automation, and using modern engineering practices to improve delivery quality and efficiency. What You Get To Do Every Day Partner with enterprise customers to understand their migration requirements and design scalable migration solutions. Develop, maintain, and enhance migration tooling and automation frameworks. Design, build, and optimize data extraction, transformation, validation, and loading (ETL) processes. Create reusable utilities that reduce implementation effort across migration projects. Use AI-assisted software development tools (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) to improve engineering productivity while maintaining high standards for code quality, security, and testing. Develop intelligent automation for data validation, field mapping, reconciliation, exception handling, and migration reporting. Build containerized migration solutions that can be deployed consistently across customer environments. Work closely with Technical Architects and Project Managers to deliver successful customer implementations. Troubleshoot complex migration issues involving APIs, databases, integrations, and application data. Continuously improve migration frameworks, engineering standards, documentation, and best practices. Maintain technical expertise across the Zendesk platform, APIs, import/export capabilities, and integration technologies. Contribute ideas that improve automation, delivery efficiency, customer experience, and overall migration quality. Basic Qualifications 3+ years of professional software engineering experience. 2+ years of Python development experience. Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, XML, CSV, and other structured data formats. Experience with Git and collaborative software development workflows. Experience troubleshooting complex data transformation and integration challenges. Experience using AI-assisted software development tools (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) as part of the software development lifecycle. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage multiple concurrent customer projects in a fast-paced environment. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field. Preferred Qualifications Experience delivering software in a Professional Services, Consulting, or customer-facing engineering environment. Experience building cloud-native applications using AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Experience building automation frameworks and developer tooling. Experience integrating with SaaS platforms through REST APIs. Familiarity with Large Language Models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, or similar) through APIs or AI development tools. Experience creating AI-assisted engineering workflows or developer automation. Understanding of software architecture, clean code principles, and software design patterns. Successful Engineers In This Role Deliver reliable, scalable migration solutions that exceed customer expectations. Build reusable automation that reduces implementation effort and improves consistency. Use AI responsibly to accelerate development while maintaining engineering excellence. Identify opportunities to eliminate manual work through automation and tooling. Communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders. Continuously improve engineering standards, migration processes, and customer outcomes. Share knowledge through documentation, mentoring, and collaboration. Title: Senior Technologist, Technology Deployment
Description: Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years. Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol. Job Description About the Team The Senior Technologist is part of the Americas Technology Deployment team and reports to the Senior Manager, Americas Technology Deployment. This role is responsible for delivering OD&I projects aligned with business priorities while providing technical leadership and support across the MCCA market for all Castrol product lines. The position plays a key role in driving technical excellence, supporting product stewardship, resolving customer and product quality issues, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement. Based in Santa Fe, Mexico City, the Senior Technologist serves as a key technical liaison between local business teams, customers, and regional and global technology specialists. Key Tasks Provide technical expertise and guidance across Castrol's automotive and industrial lubricant product lines, including product applications, specifications, formulations, and raw material interchange. Deliver customer-facing technical support, including onsite visits to investigate lubricant performance concerns, evaluate product suitability, and recommend appropriate solutions. Troubleshoot customer technical issues, coordinate oil sampling and laboratory analysis with regional technology teams and communicate findings and corrective recommendations. Provide technical training and guidance to Sales teams, customers, and other business stakeholders on lubricant technologies, product applications, and performance. Support the resolution of product quality incidents and lead technical investigations involving multiple countries or business segments. Manage regional technical challenges involving raw material shortages, regulatory requirements, product compliance, and local product registrations. Collaborate with Product Development, Research, Supply Chain, Sales, and Marketing teams to address customer needs and support product improvements. Deliver technical projects and OD&I initiatives aligned with regional business priorities and operational objectives. Monitor market trends, customer feedback, and product performance to identify opportunities for innovation, product enhancements, and continuous improvement. Develop and communicate technical updates, product claims capabilities, and new product opportunities to relevant stakeholders. Build relationships with internal subject matter experts and external technical partners to promote knowledge sharing and technical excellence. Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and coaching to less experienced colleagues. Represent Castrol on technical boards and industry forums, as required. Experience Required Bachelor's degree in Science, Engineering, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline. Ideally 5–10 years of relevant technical experience, preferably within the automotive or industrial lubricants industry. Demonstrated technical knowledge of lubricant technologies, engine oils, industrial lubricants, product specifications, applications, and performance characteristics. Experience providing technical service, application support, or troubleshooting for lubricant products and customers. Knowledge of lubricant formulations, product modifications, manufacturing processes, and raw material considerations. Experience investigating customer technical complaints, product quality issues, and lubricant performance concerns. Ability to evaluate technical problems, coordinate laboratory testing or oil analysis, and recommend practical, commercially viable solutions. Experience working with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Product Development, and Research. Understanding of product stewardship, regulatory requirements, technical compliance, and quality management practices. Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills. Excellent communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management capabilities. Ability to provide technical training, influence stakeholders, and coach less experienced colleagues. Experience working in a regional or multinational environment is preferred. Fluent in English and Spanish, both written and spoken. Title: Analista Sr. POS (Point of sale)
Description: Grupo Ruz es una empresa mexicana con 35 años de experiencia en el desarrollo y distribución de productos con marcas reconocidas. A través de nuestras unidades de negocio Mobility y Toys, creamos productos innovadores que acompañan momentos importantes en la vida de nuestros consumidores, impulsados por el talento y la pasión de nuestros colaboradores. 1. Propósito del puesto. Convertir el sell-out, el inventario en cliente y el sell-in en conclusiones y acciones concretas para sus tres socios de negocio: Comercial, Sales Finance & Commercial Planning y Marketing. Cada análisis responde: ¿crecemos?, ¿qué lo explica?, ¿dónde está el riesgo? y ¿qué hacemos? No es un puesto de armar reportes: es de entender, concluir, recomendar y dar seguimiento hasta cerrar. 2. Responsabilidades Principales: • Análisis integral. Sell-out, inventario y sell-in en piezas y pesos vs. año anterior, por cliente, marca, licencia, categoría e ítem. • Desplazamiento por marca para Marketing. Identifica qué marcas y licencias impulsar y cuáles corregir, y lo entrega a Marketing como insumo de los planes de marca y del AOP. • Riesgo de inventario. Detecta marcas con caída y alto inventario en cliente, y alerta a Sales Finance & Commercial Planning sobre posibles notas de crédito. • Calidad del dato. Valida con KAMs y Team Leaders, cuadra totales y documenta la fecha de corte. • Presentación y seguimiento. Abre con hallazgos clave y cierra acuerdos con dueño y fecha con Comercial y Marketing. 3 3. Competencias Técnicas: • Sell-in, sell-out, inventario y cobertura; precio al público vs. sell-in y descuentos. • Explicar si la venta cambió por piezas, precio o mezcla, por cliente y por marca. • Saber que el bajo desplazamiento genera notas de crédito (no las calcula). • Leer el desempeño de cada marca contra el plan (AOP). • Portales de clientes, Walmart, Chedrahui, Soriana, Excel avanzado y PowerPoint ejecutivo. . Oracle FDI como usuario de reportes; . Inglés intermedio. • Proactividad: da seguimiento y avisa antes de un retraso. • Cercanía y empatía con Comercial, Finanzas y Marketing. • Comunicación asertiva, segura ante interlocutores senior. • Estructura y hands-on: valida sus datos antes de compartir. 4. Perfil de puesto Formación: Administración, Finanzas, Economía, Mercadotecnia, Ing. Industrial o afín, titulado Experiencia: 3 a 4 años en análisis comercial, POS, planeación, finanzas comerciales o trade marketing. Industria: juguetes, consumo masivo o retail (diferencial).

Title: Solutions Engineer
Description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. Role will be based in Mexico City, Mexico We are looking for a Solution Engineer who is accustomed to solving customer’s most complex problems and closing large deals. In this role you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, provide compelling value-based demonstrations, support enterprise Proof of Concepts, and ultimately help customers grow in their use of Snowflake. As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must share our passion about reinventing the AI Data platform space, thrive in a dynamic environment and have the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get things done. You are equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, interacting with executives and talking shop with technical audiences. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO: Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at Snowflake customers and prospects Work hands-on with customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology; identify use cases, and guide the customer to successfully take them from demo to implementation, and a successful go-live. Present Customers with the innovations in Snowflake and the value these innovations add to their business. Immerse yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them. Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing. ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE: Outstanding presenting skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos. Broad range of experience within large-scale Database and/or Data Warehouse technology, ETL, analytics and cloud technologies Hands-on expertise with SQL and SQL analytics Ability to understand a customer’s specific business problems and translate these to Snowflake use cases University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience preferred Travel Required ABOUT OUR TEAM: Our Solution Engineers are customer obsessed and we believe in the value we can add and stay honest about it. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our clients successful. Our team works to ensure data is accessible, usable and valuable to everyone. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Title: Accounting Data Management – Aladdin Data -Vice President
Description: About This Role Your team The Accounting Data Management team is part of Aladdin Data and serves as a critical partner to BlackRock’s Investment Accounting and outsourced accounting business. The team manages the integrity, governance, and operational management of security, transaction, market, and accounting data used across investment accounting, regulatory reporting, portfolio operations, and client servicing. The team oversees the onboarding, validation, and maintenance of investment and accounting data while advancing automation, standardization, and scalable operating models. Through close partnership with accounting teams, portfolio operations, technology teams, data providers, and external investment managers, the team enables timely, accurate, and controlled data flows that support client reporting, regulatory obligations, and operational excellence. Your role and impact As the Accounting Data Lead, you will lead and develop a team supporting critical investment accounting data processes in Mexico. You will be responsible for strengthening data quality, operational controls, automation, and continuous improvement while helping the team deliver consistent and scalable outcomes. This role combines investment accounting knowledge, data management expertise, and people leadership. You will partner with global teams to improve processes, resolve complex data issues, enhance client outcomes, and advance BlackRock’s broader data strategy. Your Responsibilities In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: Lead, develop, and mentor a team of data professionals, managing capacity, priorities, performance, and development while fostering accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, inclusion, and operational excellence. Oversee the setup, maintenance, validation, and governance of security, transaction, market, and accounting data, ensuring its integrity, completeness, and accuracy across asset classes and data sources. Provide operational oversight of data pipelines, automated processes, exception management, and reconciliations, strengthening controls and issue-management practices to reduce operational risk. Partner with technology teams to improve data architecture, workflows, and straight-through-processing capabilities while identifying opportunities to automate, standardize, and simplify operational processes. Partner across Investment Accounting, Operations, Technology, Product, and Client Service to address complex data inquiries, identify root causes, and coordinate timely resolution across stakeholder groups. Support client onboarding, data migrations, and new implementations while building effective relationships with investment managers, custodians, market-data vendors, and other service providers. Lead and contribute to strategic initiatives focused on scalability, data quality, operating-model transformation, and platform modernization, using metrics and operational insights to improve efficiency, capacity planning, and service delivery. Your Experience Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Information Technology, Data Management, or a related field, with strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and communication capabilities. Eight or more years of relevant experience in investment operations, investment accounting, data management, or financial services, including experience leading teams or complex operational processes. Strong understanding of fixed income, equity, derivative, and alternative investments, with experience using accounting platforms, portfolio-management systems, or investment-operations workflows. Knowledge of investment accounting, fund accounting, regulatory reporting, or outsourced accounting operations, together with familiarity with data governance, data quality, risk management, and operational-control frameworks. Experience with Aladdin or comparable investment-management platforms, plus working knowledge of Structured Query Language (SQL), data analysis, automation, data-engineering concepts, and Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) processes. Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity and change, influence stakeholders across functions and levels, and take ownership of high-quality outcomes. Experience leading process automation or operational-transformation initiatives, supported by a continuous-improvement mindset and a commitment to scalable solutions, innovation, collaboration, and client-service excellence. Our Benefits To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. Our hybrid work model BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. Guidance on AI use for candidates At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. About BlackRock At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok. BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law. BlackRock will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in a manner consistent with the requirements of the law, including any applicable fair chance law.
